build_flags.detail: 242 of 242 translation units do NOT carry -ffp-contract=off (first: ../../src/Core/AI.m). Without it clang may fuse a*b+c into a single FMA, which rounds once instead of twice and changes the low bits of every float in the dump - exactly the cross-platform variation the golden policy exists to remove.

note: scenario 001: paused world, system cleared of non-station ships, 2 police + 2 pirates spawned deterministically at radius 0. Blessed from run A of tests/golden/measure_quantisation.sh; four further runs were byte-identical. NOTE the build_flags block: the shared build that produced this dump PREDATES the -ffp-contract=off pin added by bead oo-ss8, so it is recorded as UNVERIFIED rather than assumed compliant. Re-bless after the next rebuild of the shared app dir.
